title: Where the Chinese 15 cm howitzers stood
reading: South of Xiongshan, about 13 km from the Japanese guns at Sanlizhuang, within 5 km
basis: In the direction the Japanese saw the rounds come from, and beyond the reach of every Japanese gun from its position, as Ohashi remembered; within the 15 km that reaches Liujiahu and Sanlizhuang, where the rounds fell.
